content.text: What is the average rent in Storrs, CT? $2,276/month Average Rent 601 Sq Ft Average Apartment Size +8% Increase in the Last Year As of April 2026, the average rent in Storrs, CT is $2,276 per month. This is 39% higher than the national average rent price of $1,641/month, making Storrs one of the most expensive cities in the US. When you rent an apartment in Storrs, you can expect to pay about $2,117 per month for a studio, $2,276 for a one-bedroom apartment, and around $3,503 for a two-bedroom apartment. If you opt for a three-bedroom rental, you could pay $4,712 or more.
